Who We Are

A Local Contractor Built on Clean Work

Shining Networks Company L.L.C. is an electrical contracting company based in Seeb, Muscat. We specialise in electrical works up to 11 kV: new service connections for villas, residential and commercial buildings, meter installation and changing, LV & HV installation, cable laying, testing and maintenance.

  • Every job tested before handover — documented results
  • Itemised quotation before any work begins — no surprises
  • PPE, safe isolation and site discipline on every visit
  • Direct contact with the people doing your work

What We Do

Our Services

01

Service Connections

New electricity connections for villas, residential and commercial buildings — load assessment, documentation with the distribution company and final connection.

Get a Quote
02

Meter Installation & Changing

Our speciality: new meters, meter changing, meter shifting and coordination with the licensed distribution company — done clean, sealed and correct.

Get a Quote
03

LV & HV Works up to 11 kV

Distribution boards, switchgear, feeder pillars, transformers and all kinds of LV and HV installation, alteration and upgrade works.

Get a Quote
04

Villa & Building Electrification

Complete internal electrification: distribution boards, lighting, power circuits, containment and final fix for new builds and refurbishments.

Get a Quote
05

Cable Laying, Networks & Jointing

Underground ducting, armoured cable laying, terminations and joints for service mains and distribution networks.

Get a Quote
06

Testing, Earthing & Maintenance

Inspection and testing, earthing and lightning protection, fault finding, repairs and preventive maintenance for villas and commercial premises.

Get a Quote
Why Us

Reasons Clients Call Us Back

Built to DCRP Requirements

Electrical works up to 11 kV carried out to the requirements of Oman's Distribution Code Review Panel scheme.

Fast Response

Site visits arranged quickly across Muscat and Al Batinah — we know waiting for power is not an option.

Clear Quotations

Itemised pricing before work starts. The price we agree is the price you pay.

Tested & Documented

Installation testing and results you can hand to the utility or your consultant.

Local & Accountable

A Seeb-based team that answers its phone — one point of contact from survey to energisation.

Safety First

PPE, safe isolation and tidy sites — for our team, your family and your building.

How We Work

From First Call to Power On

Call or WhatsApp

Execution & Handover
